prompt: State a reasonable estimate for the mass of a medium apple, including the appropriate unit.
answer: 0.15 kg (or 150 g). Accept any value between 0.10 kg and 0.25 kg (100 g to 250 g).

mark_scheme.criterion: States a mass in the range 0.10 kg to 0.25 kg (or 100 g to 250 g) with correct unit.

hints: How many apples would make up a 1 kg bag?
Typically 5 to 8 apples make one kilogram.
solution: A typical apple has a mass of approximately 150 g = 0.15 kg (acceptable range: 0.10 kg to 0.25 kg). Both the numerical magnitude and unit are required.
teacher_walkthrough: Direct application of syllabus learning outcome 9702_t01_m01_o02.
Check that student includes a valid mass unit (kg or g).

provenance.independence_statement: Authored as an original drill on small object mass estimation.
